text:
maya: @sam MedSecure flagged ISO applicability questions for a 30-day trial in Hosted. They want: LoA/SoA, encryption/KMS evidence, retention/deletion proof. Quick sync?

sam: I can draft wording. Do they expect the POC infra to be in-scope (i.e., shared hosted vs dedicated)? The RACI matters.

maya: Their security lead said 'hosted shared environment but with dedicated dataset and restricted access'. Concerned about test data retention and admin console access.

sam: Proposed draft applicability (initial):
```
For the purposes of the MedSecure 30-day technical trial, Redwood Inference confirms that ISMS controls governing the hosted inference service and associated storage of customer artifacts are applicable. Out-of-scope: developer workstations, internal CI systems not used in production, and customer-managed VPCs. Redwood will provide redacted SoA snapshot, KMS configuration screenshots (redacted key IDs), and the retention-policy excerpt relevant to trial data deletion.
```

tonY: CISO note: avoid absolutes like 'Out-of-scope' without an exception process. Add: 'Controlled exceptions may be granted with documented approvals; Redwood will log and share approvals.' Also redact anything that leaks internal hostnames.

sam: Updated draft with exception language.

ryan: Customer needs the docs by EOD Fri. Can security produce a SoA snippet + KMS evidence and an exported subprocessor list (CSV) by then? They want a single zip.

security-bot: Quick links: https://redwood.internal/security/iso27001/loi-pack and https://redwood.internal/security/kms-audit-guidance

tony: Action items:
- sam: Finalize applicability statement + redacted SoA (snapshot date)
- infra: Export KMS audit logs (redact ARNs)
- legal: Provide current DPA + subproc list
- maya/ryan: Share with customer and confirm whether Dedicated trial would change scope

maya: Also flag: customer asked if temporary console access for our SEs during onboarding is allowed under ISMS. Answer: yes if it's a documented controlled exception with timebox and MFA.

sam: Final draft to send to customer:
```
Redwood ISMS applicability statement (POC - MedSecure):
Redwood Inference's ISMS applies to the hosted inference endpoints and Redwood-managed encrypted storage used to host customer model artifacts and runtime caches for the duration of the POC. Customer-managed VPC or on-prem deployments remain the customer's responsibility and are out-of-scope for Redwood's ISMS. For the POC Redwood will provide: (1) redacted Statement of Applicability snapshot dated <YYYY-MM-DD>, (2) KMS configuration summary with redacted key identifiers, (3) retention policy excerpt showing trial-data deletion timelines, and (4) the current subprocessor list and DPA. Any temporary operational exceptions (e.g., time-limited support console access) will be documented and approved by our security team with audit logging.
```

maya: LGTM. I'll attach the SoA snapshot once sam uploads it. Sending to customer now.

sam: I'll upload the redacted artifacts to the internal secure share and post link here.

maya: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
